name: Polymer to Fibre Engineering
description: Fundamentals of Spinning. Polymer rheology in shear as well as extensional flow. Polymer entanglements. Viscosity measurements, melt flow index analysis, Stress induced crystallization. Melt, dry and solution spinning techniques. Dry jet wet spinning. Drawing and heat-setting, Polyester, Nylon, Viscose, Polypropylene. Mechanical testing of drawn and undrawn fibres.
